description: This file contains C++ source code implementing HMAC operations using TPM2 (Trusted Platform Module 2.0) via the TSS2 ESYS API. It includes functions for performing single-call and segmented HMACs, as well as utilities for handling TPM resources and authentication.

methods.name: UniqueEsysPtr<TPM2B_DIGEST> OneshotHmac(TpmResourceManager & resource_manager,ESYS_TR key_handle,TpmAuth auth,const uint8_t * data,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Performs an HMAC operation with data fitting in a single TPM2_HMAC call.

methods.name: UniqueEsysPtr<TPM2B_DIGEST> SegmentedHmac(TpmResourceManager & resource_manager,ESYS_TR key_handle,TpmAuth key_auth,const uint8_t * data,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Performs an HMAC operation on large data using sequence commands for segmented processing.

methods.name: UniqueEsysPtr<TPM2B_DIGEST> TpmHmac(TpmResourceManager & resource_manager,ESYS_TR key_handle,TpmAuth auth,const uint8_t * data,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Selects between one-shot and segmented HMAC based on data size.

methods.name: UniqueEsysPtr<TPM2B_DIGEST> TpmHmacWithContext(TpmResourceManager & resource_manager,const std::string & context,const uint8_t * data,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Performs HMAC with a specific context, reusing a persistent key.
